item.title: Franklin Templeton Wins SEC Clearance for Tokenized Crypto Funds
item.summary: Franklin Templeton has secured clearance from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to integrate tokenized crypto assets into traditional investment funds, marking a significant development in the convergence of blockchain-based assets and conventional financial products.
